notes.title: Age of Rivals is back!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27912055/17e67569d94ce38db91ad524de58ef081ee34beb.png[/img]

Announcing [b]Bannerlands[/b], the official sequel to Age of Rivals! I'll be releasing a demo and/or playtest soon, and I'm very eager for feedback.  Just like I did with the original, I plan on evolving the game based on what players say.

I hope you wishlist the game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3495400/Bannerlands
and follow us at https://darkinertia.com/ for more details soon!  

Thank you for playing Age of Rivals and for your continued support!

Feature Highlights:

[list]
[*] Procedurally generated campaigns
[*] Story-driven diplomacy and quests
[*] Battle in locations with unique decks 
[*] More streamlined/strategic battle mechanics
[*] Deck customization
[*] Passive abilities
[*] Card upgrades
[*] Unique rival cards and starting decks
[*] New cards and abilities
[*] Multiple game modes and difficulties
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for July 2022
notes.content:
Due to our data backend provider discontinuing their service, AoR will no longer have online (cloud) accounts. Your data will now be stored on your device only. All content (card packs, cards, rivals) will always be fully unlocked. Coins, quests, and campaigns will just be for fun. Multiplayer games will continue to work as normal. See www.darkinertia.com for more information. 

Thank you for your continued support as we work to ensure that Age of Rivals will always be playable.

notes.title: Update: Several Bugfixes
notes.content:
Update 3.13 fixes several reported bugs:
- Cards that lose all culture no longer show a visible value of 0. This was confusing with respect to abilities that target cards with culture (like Onagers).
- Sometimes player names didn’t show up in the end game stats dialog.
- Sometimes icons weren’t showing in the right location in ability text when opening card packs.
- When Reinforcements get knocked out or blocked, the buffed card no longer incorrectly loses all its attack.
- Abilities that are blocked no longer incorrectly trigger when ruined (such as Ruiner of All Things).
- When a card that is buffed by Assacani or Chariots gets swapped (by Master Thief), it now correctly loses the buff.
- Temple of Protection will no longer incorrectly waste its ability trying to save Shock Troops.

http://robotogames.com/updates/

notes.title: Update: Usability Improvements
notes.content:
Update 3.11 includes player-requested usability improvements:
- Click on your rival's portrait and tap "Mute" to mute all enemy chat messages.
- Slowed down animation during pre-final-round display of all city cards.
- New "Main Menu" page in rulebook to explain alliances, missions, monthly tournament, various game types and aspects of multiplayer.
- Added a button to access the online monthly leaders page
- Showing how many card packs are left to unlock all content.

http://robotogames.com/updates/

notes.title: Update: Faster Progression
notes.content:
Today's update features 30% higher coin rewards for all game types and 
coin rewards even when losing for all game types.  Now you can unlock all cards in the game faster and earn your way to fully unlocked rivals in no time.  

Is Lorenzo's Prince in Hiding giving you a hard time?  At least now you'll earn coins every time he trounces you!  

Full details at http://robotogames.com/updates/.

notes.title: Update: No Internet Required!
notes.content:
You can now play completely offline without needing to register or log in!  Almost all aspects of the game can be enjoyed as an anonymous offline user.  The only things you have to log in for are multiplayer, Alliances, and monthly tournament stats, because these features all depend on a server.  More details here: http://robotogames.com/faq-support-forums/

Also, now the intro missions are dismissible just like the later missions.  You can still only dismiss one mission per 24 hours.  But now you can get rid of that one mission you've been ignoring since the start.

notes.title: Update: Password Management and More
notes.content:
Today's update includes better password management features.  You can still email support@robotogames.com to request a password reset, but now you can change your password in-game any time you like.  We will continue to improve in-game account management over time.

We have also adjusted the difficulty of the Hard Prince-In-Hiding challenge level.  Now Lorenzo begins this level with negative VP (-6).  

Thanks for the continued feedback!

notes.title: New Balance Update and More
notes.content:
Today's update includes our 2nd round of card balance changes, as well as a few other player-requested changes.  Full details on our blog: http://robotogames.com/blog/2017/4/27/update-balance-changes-and-more.

Summary:
[list]
[*]Friend games no longer have a turn timer.
[*]You will now hear an audio warning during timed games when you only have 5 seconds left. This will only happen if you have Sound Effects turned on.
[*]The Normal AI is now a little easier. The Hard AI is still the same.
[*]Warmonger -1 attack
[*]Silencers -1 culture
[*]Patrons -1 gold cost
[*]Arms Dealers -1 armor, +1 attack, -1 gold cost
[*]Brilliant Tactic -1 gold cost (now free)
[*]Blind Bolt Throwers -1 base attack (ability unchanged)
[/list]

notes.title: Today's update
notes.content:
Based on player feedback, we have made some changes to the game. Specifically, with today's update:
- Now you can earn coins winning a Friend game as long as the game completes.
- Now you can earn the highest rewards playing multiplayer OR vs. the hard computer. Previously the highest rewards were reserved for multiplayer games only. Easy computer games will also give rewards for wins, but a bit lower. 

Furthermore, now more missions will count progress in more modes. Previously it was heavily skewed towards missions that could only be completed in Vs Anyone mode.

Hopefully these changes will allow players who prefer to play vs. Friends or vs. the Computer to progress through the content at a good pace. 

Thanks for the feedback and keep it coming!
